node.statement: Apply lem-maincb-stage2-call-envelope to the matching state constructed in node 1.3.1.2 and the exact tagged current reset isomorphism from node 1.3.1.1. Its remaining hypotheses hold because U is nonempty, j is outside U but in the same class, R=U union {j}, nodes 1.1.2-1.1.3 give epsilon <= W.e_s2/W.K2, epsilon_U=W.L*epsilon, epsilon_R=W.L*epsilon, t_2=W.K2*epsilon, the required scale dominations and corner typing, and node 1.1.1 fixes W with the coefficient and witness conditions of the envelope. The conclusion is the explicit Stage-2 EXT raw-call datum in A_R with total defect at most C_s2^0*t_2.
